# Global Debt Deep Dive Analysis

Report 122 | Published 2023-10-29 | Evaluated 2026-11-07

[Original member article](https://www.lynalden.com/premium-2023-10-29/) | [Article index](README.md) | [Structured review](../data/reviews/122.json)

Debt structure, Egypt devaluation, and gold breakout.

Egypt devaluation timing and gold breakout were strong, dated successes. The S&P real-peak delay failed by June 2024, while the full-decade claim remains open. Restaurant resilience worked. Country asset/liability analysis is useful but must respect ownership, maturity and legal mandates; GPIF is not a freely deployable currency reserve. The Egyptian inflation sequence was less accurate than the exchange-rate direction.

**Coverage:** Read all blocks 0-134 and 26 image labels. Includes real-equity horizon, restaurant resilience, war risk, BTC thresholds/ETFs, debt-versus-reserve distinctions, country investment views, Egypt timing and gold confirmation. Personal portfolio trims are not reconstructed trades.

| Field | Assessment |

The price index surpassed its late 2021 CPI-adjusted peak by June 5 2024, roughly seven months later. That is inconsistent with the asserted very long delay; dividend reinvestment would strengthen the counterevidence.

**Direction:** Contradicted for the defined proposition.

**Timing:** No fixed deadline stated.

**Mechanism:** Outcome evidence does not independently identify the proposed causal mechanism.

**Reviewer confidence:** high

**Outcome evidence:**

- [Real S&P peak comparison](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/SP500) | S&P Dow Jones / FRED | 2026-11-07 | Verified in the audit

Latest-vintage daily SP 500 divided by same-month CPIAUCSL: late 2021 maximum at December 29, 4793.06/CPI 280.845. First post-October 29 2023 exceedance June 5 2024, 5354.03/CPI 313.044. Price index excludes dividends; monthly deflator is ex-post, not a tradable signal. CPI source https://fred.stlouisfed.org/series/CPIAUCSL .

Sales rose 8.70% nominally and 3.01% after general CPI adjustment from September 2023 to September 2025. This supports moderate growth/stagnation rather than recession collapse; near-two-year endpoint avoids missing October CPI.

**Direction:** Supported for the defined proposition.

**Timing:** Couple years

**Mechanism:** Outcome evidence does not independently identify the proposed causal mechanism.

**Reviewer confidence:** high

**Outcome evidence:**

- [Food services sales](https://fred.stlouisfed.org/data/MRTSSM722USS) | Census Bureau via FRED | 2026-11-07 | Verified in the audit

Seasonally adjusted sales Sep 2023 $79,889 m; Sep 2025 $86,837 m, up 8.697%. CPIAUCSL 307.276 to 324.245 gives 3.009% gain after general CPI adjustment. September endpoint avoids missing October 2025 CPI; not restaurant-specific volume deflation.

## Framework lessons

- External debt currency and accessible reserves matter more than gross debt alone.

## Verification limitations

- Current snapshot is not an authenticated publication-date vintage.
- Image labels were inventoried; chart images were not inspected.
- No portfolio or equity total returns are inferred from business results.
